content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Platforms often impose high fees and restrictive policies that limit your earning potential. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on each sale, which can quickly diminish your profits. In contrast, using NOWPayments allows you to accept Bitcoin with only a 0.5% fee. This difference means that for 100 sales of a $97 ebook, you retain an additional $921—a significant advantage for any digital creator looking to maximize their revenue.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you begin, ensure you have the necessary tools for deployment. You will need a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, a NOWPayments account for cryptocurrency transactions, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Additionally, prepare the digital files you plan to sell, such as your ebook, and ensure you have your pricing set. This foundational setup is crucial for seamless operations.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To accept Bitcoin, integrate NOWPayments into your infrastructure. Start by creating a payment link for your ebook, which allows customers to pay directly with Bitcoin. Next, set up Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate the delivery of your ebook upon successful payment confirmation. This setup ensures your customers receive their product instantly, enhancing their buying experience and reducing manual work on your end.
Eliminate platform fees and retain more profit with a 0.5% transaction cost.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is established, it’s time to go live. Publish your ebook on your chosen hosting platform, and promote your payment link. Monitor your first transaction carefully to ensure everything works smoothly—from payment processing to file delivery. This initial launch will provide insights into your setup, allowing you to make any necessary adjustments for future sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing your first transactions, focus on scaling your operations. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access all necessary blueprints and templates for expanding your digital storefront. Optimize your marketing strategies to reach a broader audience, and consider adding more products to your catalog. As your sales grow, your infrastructure will adapt without the limitations of traditional payment platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Achieve full ownership of your digital sales infrastructure—no dependencies.

If you’re looking to expand your digital product offerings without the limitations of major payment platforms, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides all the blueprints and templates needed to establish a robust online store. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create accounts on GitHub or Cloudflare for hosting. 2. Sign up for NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. 3. Prepare your digital product files for sale. 4. Set your pricing and create payment links via NOWPayments. 5. Implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for automated delivery. 6. Publish your ebook on your chosen platform. 7. Monitor your first transactions for any issues. 8. Use the Complete Builder Kit to scale your operations.

You can use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for automating product delivery. These tools allow you to send files to customers automatically once their payment is confirmed.

A sovereign commerce stack gives you complete ownership of your infrastructure, reducing dependency on third-party platforms, minimizing fees, and ensuring you keep more of your profits.

Yes, you can sell multiple digital products through your sovereign commerce stack. Simply create additional payment links and automate the delivery for each product.
